findings.claim: Suppressing diagnostics for types and members defined in referenced assemblies is consistent with the product's deliberate ownership model: the defining assembly validates and formats its own types, so the consuming compilation need not report those member diagnostics.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed and receive no formatter or MsgPack003/004/005 diagnostics from the compiling assembly; the defining assembly owns validation and formatting.
